g.text: A periodic train opens into a solitary pulse
The pulse keeps a finite depth while the separation between pulses diverges. Its mean approaches the background because a single depression
occupies a vanishing fraction of the period. The full ODE identity, mean formula, extrema, and this limiting profile are checked by the accompanying script.
